verdict.rationale: The docs give a concrete recurring-schedule example: checking a planning channel each weekday at 9 AM for four weeks and updating a checklist [dots-docs-14]. They also reference "future scheduled runs" as a distinct concept from the current task [dots-docs-22]. The dot runs in the cloud while your computer is off [dots-docs-2] and reaches out with results, routing them to channels like Slack [dots-docs-1][dots-docs-6]. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of one-off timed scheduling, dedicated documentation on viewing, editing, or cancelling scheduled runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
